title: OpenArt launches an expert-led benchmark for creative AI models
friendlyTitle: A new leaderboard compares image and video AI by creative job
summary: OpenArt published an Arena that ranks image and video models using evaluations organised around professional tasks including advertising, film, animation, graphic design, editing and lip-sync. Its first tables separate overall performance from use-case-specific rankings rather than naming one universal winner.
friendlySummary: OpenArt ranks creative models for work such as ads, films, animation, design and editing. Different models can lead in different kinds of work.
whyItMatters: Creative teams usually care about a particular job, not an abstract model score. A task-specific comparison can help narrow trials, though buyers should inspect the methodology and test shortlisted models with their own prompts, rights requirements and production constraints.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The best model depends on what you need to make. Use the rankings as a shortlist, then test with your own work and rules.
